entries.source: The target is crippled, reducing melee, spellcasting and mind speed by %d%%.
entries.target: 目标被致残，降低 %d%% 近战、施法和精神速度。

entries.source: but nobody knew why they suddenly became evil
entries.target: 但是没有人知道为什么他们突然变得邪恶了

entries.source: The farportal seems to be inactive
entries.target: 这个远行传送门关闭着
暴击时 时空溅射伤害

entries.source: The timeline is too fractured to do this now.
entries.target: 目前的时间线过于破碎，你现在无法这么做。

entries.source: #F53CBE#You revel in attacking a weakened foe! (+%d hate)
entries.target: #F53CBE#你沉醉于攻击一个虚弱的敌人！（+%d 仇恨）

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#20%#LAST# chance to stun, blind, pin, confuse, or silence the target for 3 turns
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#20%#LAST#几率震慑、混乱、沉默、定身或致盲目标3回合
暴击时 精神溅射伤害

entries.source: Stealthy fighters trying to achieve victory with trickery. Be careful or they will steal your life!
entries.target: 善用诡计取胜的潜行斗士。小心，他们会偷走你的生命！

entries.source:
Increases weapon damage by %d%% and physical power by 30 when using slings.
		Also, increases your reload rate by %d.
entries.target:
使用投石索时提高 %d%% 武器伤害，获得 30 物理强度。
		同时，每次装填额外恢复 %d 枚弹药。

entries.source: The target is immune to all detrimental effects.
entries.target: 目标免疫所有异常状态。

entries.source: %s tries to enter the wormhole but a violent force pushes it back.
entries.target: %s试图进入虫洞但是一股猛力将其强行推送了回来。

entries.source: %s exudes a corrupted gas as it dies.

entries.target: 你的傀儡当前尚未被激活。

entries.source: Rotten and reeking. It still twitches occasionally.
entries.target: 这块肉腐烂且散发着恶臭，偶尔还会抽搐。

entries.source: Reality asserts itself and forces the wormhole shut.
entries.target: 现实世界进行自我调谐强行关闭了虫洞。

entries.source: Bits of dry flesh still cling to this ancient bone.
entries.target: 在这个古代的骨头上仍残留着一点肉块。
